code='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for row in out:\n        if len(row) < 2:\n            continue\n        runs = []\n        for value in row:\n            if not runs or runs[-1][0] != value:\n                runs.append([value, 1])\n            else:\n                runs[-1][1] += 1\n        if len(runs) == 2:\n            marker = runs[0][0]\n            start = runs[0][1]\n        elif len(runs) > 2:\n            counts = Counter(row)\n            marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)\n            start = next(i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker)\n        else:\n            continue\n        for i in range(start, len(row)):\n            if row[i] != marker:\n                row[i] = 1\n    return out\n'''

# analyze alignment by mismatches of test data rows
for a,b in [(test[0],test[7]),(test[1],test[8])]:
    vals=[]
    for shift in range(-8,9):
        pairs=[(a[i],b[i+shift]) for i in range(len(a)) if 0<=i+shift<len(b)]
        score=sum(x==y for x,y in pairs)
        mism=len(pairs)-score
        vals.append((shift,score,mism,len(pairs)))
    print(sorted(vals,key=lambda x:(-x[1],x[2]))[:8])
